execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."auth_accounts" (
  "access_token" text,
  "access_token_expires_at" timestamptz,
  "account_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "id_token" text,
  "password" text,
  "provider_id" text NOT NULL,
  "refresh_token" text,
  "refresh_token_expires_at" timestamptz,
  "scope" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auth_sessions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_agent" text,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auth_users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "email_verified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."auth_verifications" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "identifier" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."folder_permissions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "folder_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "level" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text,
  "user_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "folder_permissions_level_check_12e36959" CHECK ("level" IN ('read', 'write', 'manage')),
  CONSTRAINT "folder_permissions_member_or_role_b68863bf" CHECK ((user_id IS NULL) <> (role IS NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "folder_permissions_role_check_c3e07ca3" CHECK ("role" IN ('owner', 'admin', 'editor', 'viewer'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."folders" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "inherits_permissions" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "parent_id" uuid,
  "team_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."team_members" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "team_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("team_id", "user_id"),
  CONSTRAINT "team_members_role_check_c3e07ca3" CHECK ("role" IN ('owner', 'admin', 'editor', 'viewer'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."teams" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "auth_user_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
